data.name: EVA Awakening
data.detailed_description:
Every choice reshapes your reality.

EVA Awakening is a cinematic VR psychological science-fiction experience that blends immersive storytelling, environmental puzzles, and meaningful player choices into a single narrative journey.

Designed exclusively for virtual reality, EVA Awakening places you aboard the Aeon Express, a mysterious train crossing an impossible world where memories become places, machines question their creators, and every decision subtly transforms your perception of reality.

As the boundaries between human consciousness and artificial intelligence begin to collapse, you'll uncover hidden truths, confront your own beliefs, and decide how the story unfolds.

"My existence is not a mistake. It is a question."

A journey beyond consciousness

Every carriage of the Aeon Express reveals a different fragment of a much larger mystery.

Explore richly detailed environments, solve immersive physical puzzles, uncover hidden memories, and interact with characters whose intentions are never entirely clear.

Your decisions influence conversations, relationships, discoveries and ultimately the direction of the narrative.

There are no simple answers.
Only different perspectives.

Features

  • Built exclusively for Virtual Reality, with natural interactions designed for maximum presence.

  • A psychological science-fiction narrative where every choice shapes your experience.

  • Multiple branching paths and dialogue choices with lasting consequences.

  • Environmental, logical and physical puzzles fully integrated into the story.

  • Cinematic storytelling inspired by psychological thrillers and modern science fiction.

  • A mysterious cast of characters, each hiding their own motivations.

  • Highly detailed interactive environments aboard the Aeon Express.

  • Original soundtrack composed by Gabriele Boschi.

  • Spatial 3D audio designed to maximize immersion.

  • Headphones strongly recommended.

Enter the Aeon Express

Reality is not breaking.

It is awakening.

Every conversation.
Every discovery.
Every decision.

Will bring you one step closer to understanding EVA... or becoming part of her.

data.short_description: A cinematic VR psychological sci-fi experience aboard the mysterious Aeon Express. Solve immersive puzzles, shape the narrative, and question the nature of consciousness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR compatible headset required (SteamVR). Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta Quest 2/3 (via Link), Windows Mixed Reality
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR compatible headset required (SteamVR). Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta Quest 2/3 (via Link), Windows Mixed Reality
  • Additional Notes: SSD
